reason: I'll start with the injury so the platelet plug has a break to form at. The story explains what the rough edge does, though I don't know exactly how this action will show it.
expectation: I expect the rough edge to cause a small cut in the skin and blood vessel.

alternatives.reason: The enzymes are labelled as helping make reinforcing threads, but I want to see the break first.

effect: The cut shows a narrowed vessel that is still leaking, so a plug is needed.
reaction: The narrowing was a little surprising, but the leak makes the next step clear.
reason: I'll add the platelets to the cut to start stopping the leak.
expectation: I expect the platelets to gather at the damaged vessel and form a plug, though it may still need reinforcement.

alternatives.reason: Making reinforcing threads also fits a goal, but I'll form the plug first.

effect: The platelets formed a plug that slows the leak; it still needs reinforcing.
reaction: The picture makes it clear how the platelets help, though the leak is only slowed.
reason: The only offered combination uses the enzymes labelled as helping clotting proteins form threads.
expectation: I expect the protein and enzymes to produce threads that can reinforce the plug.

effect: The proteins formed a branching mesh, ready to reinforce the platelet plug and stop the bleeding.
reaction: The mesh makes the threads' reinforcing role easy to picture.
reason: The only offered combination brings the mesh and platelet plug together.
expectation: I expect the threads to reinforce the plug and stop the bleeding.

effect: The mesh reinforced the plug and stopped the bleeding, but the skin remains open and needs to heal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the two parts work together; the still-open skin leaves me curious about repair.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the platelet plug with the protein mesh was most worthwhile because it showed how both parts stop the leak.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the threads felt a little less engaging because the label already explained the pairing and it was the only offered action.

surprise.text: I was a little surprised that the damaged vessel narrowed but was still leaking.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly arbitrary. The enzyme pairing was guided by its label, though I didn't learn exactly how the enzymes make threads.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the open skin heals after the bleeding stops.
